_meta.purpose: Real Gemini 2.5 Flash token counts, captured once so future changes to pixelpath/packing.py or the cost model can be checked against real numbers without spending API calls again.
_meta.tier: free (no billing account) — NOT independently confirmed to tokenize/bill identically to paid tier
_meta.fixed_prompt: Describe this image in one word.
_meta.method: prompt_token_count from response.usage_metadata, minus fixed_prompt_token_count, isolates image-only token cost
_meta.headline_finding: Token cost is FLAT (258) across all tested image dimensions from 100x100 to 3000x4000 — confirmed independently outside the batch script. Gemini 2.5 Flash does NOT scale image token cost with pixel area/tile count in the range tested. This directly contradicts pixelpath/packing.py's current step-function-per-512px-tile model, which was written with an Anthropic-style formula in mind and had never been calibrated against any real provider.
_meta.verdict: packing.py is NOT trustworthy for Gemini as-is. Root cause is understood (wrong cost model shape, not noisy/inconsistent data) but packing.py's logic was deliberately not touched in this probe per the task scope (measurement only).

independent_sanity_check.note: Run outside the batch script to rule out a script artifact, with deliberately extreme sizes
